  • Method Details

    • update

      public void update()
      Updates the state of the enemy. Increments the update counter and checks if it has reached the threshold. If the counter exceeds the threshold, it calls the updateMovement method and resets the counter.

    • updateMovement

      public void updateMovement()
      Updates the movement speed of the enemy. Generates a random number between 0 and 6 and sets the movement speed based on the random value. Possible movement directions are up, down, left, right, or no movement.

    • shoot

      public void shoot(String projectileDirection)
      Increments the counter and checks if it has reached the threshold. If the counter exceeds the threshold, it creates a new projectile and resets the counter.
      Parameters:
      projectileDirection - The direction in which the projectile will be shot.
